purpose: One affected/control replay after clarifying the operational meaning of chart.create column_headers. Descriptions only; model selects all ranges and flags. No new API, validation, gate, full-189 run, or promotion.

repair_hypothesis.description: Explain that column_headers consumes the first row inside the selected ranges, not a worksheet header outside them, so the model preserves the first observation when selecting data-only ranges.
repair_hypothesis.expected_observable_change: Order 15 selects false for data-only ranges or includes the observed header row when selecting true; native and saved charts retain all monthly observations and the original evaluator passes. Order 2 retains its pass.
repair_hypothesis.stop_signal: One fresh guest and one attempt per task, 100 global steps, 1800 seconds, or existing supervisor/disk stop. Preserve both results, freeze source through exit, and do not repeat unchanged.
repair_hypothesis.prior_attempt_disposition: The chart-feedback v1 pair completed with Order 2 passed and Order 15 failed. Order 15 selected total-only ranges but treated their first data row as labels. The selected-header snapshot v1 changed only two production tool descriptions and returned a valid false-header chart call; no tool executed and no task pass is claimed.
